notes:
Original p is the printed bound p < .004, not the .003 supplied in the replication authors’ retrospective Table 1. Original OCR spacing retained in source quote; n words transcribed as numeric 108. Replication Table 4 locator resolves to PDF page 15, printed page 13; selected ski row because original Study 1 uses only that scenario. Table quotes collapse layout whitespace. F retained as requested test statistic; no metric conversion. Reported success is scoped to the authors’ explicit Experiment 1 exception, not their overall mostly successful ski conclusion across samples. Authors caution that Experiment 1 was knowingly under-powered. Source is author-hosted accepted preprint with supplements; target Experiment 1 has 43 students, not later MTurk samples.
Completion source review (n_r): Table 4 explicitly labels n = 43 for Experiment 1, whose ski ANOVA is identified through original Experiment 1 = ski. Main analysis retained participants; final sample is independently described on p. 7.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly except Experiment 1 from the ski one-way ANOVA and large-vs-small replication claim. Vocabulary failed applies to this assigned Experiment 1 target; the broader mostly-successful ski conclusion pools four samples.
